Name: Tortilla-Based Health and Energy
Author: fireredlily
Description:
Have you ever wanted to feel more like a burrito? Measure your player's stamina with Guacamole and Salsa or Beans instead of boring old energy and health! Includes a retextured health/stamina bar background, a custom texture for the newly renamed Guacamole Tonic (formerly Energy Tonic) and renames references to the player's health and energy. Choose between Beans or Salsa as your health (filling) with the config options.

i18n-supported for anyone who wishes to create translations of this mod. Generic Mod Config Menu is supported!

Downloads.Description: The initial release of the mod. Renames player health and energy on the UI and on various objects. Retextures the HP/Energy bar, HP/Energy icons, and Energy Tonic.
